snippet.title: Teaching with Games: GLPC Case Study: Joel
snippet.description: Joel Levin, a school technology integrator, works with second graders at Columbia Grammar and Preparatory School in New York City.  Through his use of MinecraftEDU, a version of the popular commercial game Minecraft modified for educational purposes, Joel leads his 2nd grade class through structured game-based scenarios that emphasis self-directed learning, collaboration between students, and positive social interactions.
